# VEDRISHI AI - MASTER MEMPALACE
> Kya kaam hai, kyu hai, kaise karna hai - sab yahan

---

## PROJECT OVERVIEW
- **Project Name**: VedRishi AI
- **Goal**: AI-powered Hindu spiritual guide for global Hindu users
- **Team**: Sirf 2 log - User (Founder) + AI (Developer)
- **Strategy**: Pehle app/website launch, phir Vietnam mein company kholenge
- **Budget**: Free tools only (training phase)
- **Timeline**: 7-10 days model training, 6-8 weeks full product

---

## PHASE BREAKDOWN

### PHASE 1: DATASET (Day 1-3) [PENDING]
- **Kya karna hai**: Scriptures se verses extract karke JSONL format mein dalna
- **Kyu**: AI ko sacred text sikhaana hai taaki wo sahi jawab de
- **Kaise**: AI tools se verses extract, clean, structure karna
- **Status**: NOT STARTED
- **Next Action**: Bhagavad Gita API se data download karna

### PHASE 2: MODEL TRAINING (Day 4-5) [PENDING]
- **Kya karna hai**: Qwen 2.5 7B ko QLoRA se fine-tune karna
- **Kyu**: Hindi/Sanskrit spiritual content ke liye best model
- **Kaise**: Unsloth Cloud ya Together AI par free tier se
- **Status**: NOT STARTED
- **Dependencies**: Phase 1 complete hona chahiye

### PHASE 3: RAG SETUP (Day 5-6) [PENDING]
- **Kya karna hai**: Verse accuracy ke liye RAG framework lagana
- **Kyu**: Model hallucination karega bina RAG ke
- **Kaise**: Pinecone/ChromaDB + LangChain
- **Status**: NOT STARTED

### PHASE 4: EVALUATION (Day 6-7) [PENDING]
- **Kya karna hai**: 100 queries test karna, tone check, safety check
- **Kyu**: Release se pehle quality ensure karna zaroori hai
- **Kaise**: Manual audit + automated metrics
- **Status**: NOT STARTED

### PHASE 5: MVP BUILD (Week 3-4) [PENDING]
- **Kya karna hai**: WhatsApp Bot ya Web Chat banana
- **Kyu**: Pehle simple version launch, feedback lo, phir improve karo
- **Kaise**: Simple frontend + API integration
- **Status**: NOT STARTED

### PHASE 6: MONETIZATION (Week 5-6) [PENDING]
- **Kya karna hai**: Payment gateway + subscription system
- **Kyu**: Bina earning ke company nahi khol sakte
- **Kaise**: Razorpay/Stripe integration
- **Status**: NOT STARTED

### PHASE 7: LAUNCH (Week 6-8) [PENDING]
- **Kya karna hai**: Social media marketing + beta launch
- **Kyu**: Users chahiye feedback ke liye
- **Kaise**: Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts
- **Status**: NOT STARTED

### PHASE 8: COMPANY (Vietnam) [FUTURE]
- **Kya karna hai**: Vietnam mein legally company register karna
- **Kyu**: Jab stable earning ho tabhi kholenge
- **Kaise**: Local CA se baat karni hogi
- **Status**: FAR FUTURE

## RULES
1. Sab kuch free mein karna hai (training phase)
2. Security first - koi bhi shortcut nahi
3. Har step document karna hai
4. Lessons learned txt files mein dalna hai
5. Research saari researches txt files mein
6. GitHub MemPalace se track karna hai
7. Quality > Quantity (har cheez well-structured)
